single_source_rule: US 4i.1-4i.6 must consume only the US 4i.7 output datasets listed in the manifest; direct raw CSV or third-party price sources are not permitted for displayed figures.

methods.description: Per-state festival significance from the top 50 sample items, 3-sigma outlier exclusion, robust baseline and 5 percent rise threshold.
